Ashley: Quick random Q — if you could legally change your middle name to a single emoji, which emoji and why? do NOT overthink :eyes:

Ravi: 😂 — middle name becomes 😂. would confuse tax forms, 100% worth it

Mei: 🐙 — tentacle energy. also good at parties

Jordan: ⚡️ — fast and loud. looks aggressive on coffee mugs

Priya: 🤷‍♀️ — I already live this emoji, so it fits

Tom: 🧦 — because socks. personal hill to die on

dev-bot: heads-up: legal name changes might need paperwork. check: https://gov.example/name-change

giphy: [GIF: shrugging] :shrug:

Ashley: Also curious — has anyone actually tried to put an emoji on an official form? any state horror stories? :thinking_face:

Ravi: Not official, but my cousin tried to add a heart to his driver's license name, clerk raised an eyebrow

Mei: I once set my credit-card nickname to "Mei 🐉" and customer support kept asking about special characters

Priya: fun fact: court clerk here — most jurisdictions don't accept pictograms for legal names, but display names? go wild

Jordan: Slack display-name update time? 3pm meeting: "Emoji Middle Name Club" :tada:

Tom: I'm in. Changing to Tom 🧦 in 3, 2, 1... :rocket:

Ashley: Starting with Ashley 🐝 — busy bee vibes. meet at the virtual watercooler at 3. :honeybee:

Priya: :thumbsup:

Mei: :heart:

End.
